# @rnw-community/nestjs-webpack-swc

> NestJS webpack and SWC configuration helpers for fast local development: ready-made dev (HMR) and production webpack
> configs using `swc-loader`, an HMR bootstrap helper, and a TypeORM migrations loader for webpack builds. Peer
> dependencies: `@nestjs/common`, `webpack`, `webpack-node-externals`, `swc-loader`, `@swc/*`, and webpack plugins.

The webpack configs are consumed through the `@rnw-community/nestjs-webpack-swc/get-nestjs-webpack-dev.config` and
`@rnw-community/nestjs-webpack-swc/get-nestjs-webpack-prod.config` subpath entry points. Webpack writes a filesystem
cache to `.build_cache` in the package root, which should be git-ignored.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Installation, webpack and HMR configuration, scripts, and known webpack / SWC issues.

## Guides

- [Scripts package.json](readme.md#scripts-packagejson): `build` and `start:dev` scripts using `nest build --webpack`.
- [.gitignore](readme.md#gitignore): Ignoring the `.build_cache` webpack filesystem cache folder.
- [Possible webpack issues](readme.md#possible-webpack-issues): Packages relying on absolute / relative paths under webpack bundling.
- [Typeorm CLI](readme.md#typeorm-cli): Running the TypeORM CLI through `ts-node` when migrations are no longer emitted to dist.
- [SWC bindings](readme.md#swc-bindings): Fixing `Bindings not found` when the container architecture differs from the host.

## API reference

- [`getNestJSWebpackDevConfig`](readme.md#development-webpack-configuration): Subpath `@rnw-community/nestjs-webpack-swc/get-nestjs-webpack-dev.config`; dev webpack config with SWC, hot module replacement, and auto-run of the bundle.
- [`getNestJSWebpackProdConfig`](readme.md#production-webpack-configuration): Subpath `@rnw-community/nestjs-webpack-swc/get-nestjs-webpack-prod.config`; production webpack config with minified SWC output and Terser keeping class names.
- [`handleNestJSWebpackHmr`](readme.md#nestjs-hmr): Accepts webpack hot updates and closes the NestJS app or microservice on dispose.
- [`HmrModuleInterface`](readme.md#nestjs-hmr): Shape of the webpack `module` object (optional `hot` with `accept` / `dispose`) passed to `handleNestJSWebpackHmr`.
- [`importTypeormWebpackMigrations`](readme.md#typeorm-migrations): Collects every exported migration class from a webpack `require.context` for TypeORM configuration.
